description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `command-not-tsc.json` is refused by `command`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own: without `replaceCommands`, a case that passed; with `check` set to `coverage`, a case that fired another check.
